name: ANSI/IEEE current-limiting circuit breaker symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for current-limiting circuit breaker, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: A current-limiting breaker form identifies a fault-interruption characteristic associated with the selected breaker. It does not depict continuous regulation of the feeder current. The limiting designation needs the applicable manufacturer's let-through information.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Associate the limiting annotation with the breaker rather than the load.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Fault-current limitation is not the same circuit function as an adjustable current regulator.
